text: The fatal night, just after eleven: Julia asks Helen about a whistle in the night
why: ¶35-36 state that on the fatal night, at eleven, Julia rose to leave, paused at the door and asked Helen about whistling in the dead of the night.

text: Who was whistling in the dead of the night?
why: Julia's question in ¶36 directly raises this, and the wording does not point at an answer.
